description: Seed-1 pilot for descriptive GaWF Jacobian and effective-connectivity analysis on balanced joint-switch CM-MNIST events.
notes: Pilot uses seed 1, one event per each of 90 new digit-by-sector cells, and a symmetric pre/post10 joint-switch window.
The pilot validates runtime, artifact size, and feasible balance across candidate window radii 10, 20, 32, and 50 before formal execution.
The failed pilot_v1 output is retained and is not reused or overwritten.
Pilot_v2 completed in 106 seconds; all four CSV outputs had the expected row counts and finite numeric values.
After clean-window and reset exclusion, pre/post10 retained 6-18 events per cell; pre/post20 retained 1-10, while radii 32 and 50 left some cells empty.
